NS-1 requires at least one in-app message AND at least one in-app call before cancelling, so the condition is not satisfied [F5][NS-1].

Because a NS-1 condition fails, the fee is voided and the rider is not charged: refund_full of the $5.00 fee on record [F8][NS-2].
